text:
rachel: FYI I'm seeing unredacted PII in the Go sampleapp logs at DEBUG. This one is odd: reqids look fine, but structured JSON logs contain raw payloads while text logs are redacted.

devon: interesting. Is this the new structured logger we shipped (logx v1.2) or the old one?

rachel: logx v1.2 + otel-go-hook v0.8. Middleware order: we init otel, then request id, then redactor.

kai: can you paste examples? structured vs text?

rachel: snippet:```
# text log (good):
2026-04-01T17:00:03Z INFO reqid=go-9a2 route=/embed payload="{REDACTED}"
# json log (leak):
{"time":"2026-04-01T17:00:03Z","level":"debug","reqid":"go-9a2","payload":{"email":"bob@acme.com","phone":"+1400"},"redactor":"skipped"}
```

devon: aha. redactor runs as a text transformer for the stdout formatter, but the JSON encoder bypasses it. We added a faster path in logx that encodes structs directly which doesn't go through the middleware-based scrubber.

kai: so two paths: 1) ensure redactor is applied to the structured payload before encoding, 2) add a post-encode inspection that zeroes sensitive keys. Prefer (1).

rachel: also noticed this only shows up when otel trace context is present. Could be that otel hook swaps logger instance with context-bound logger that has a different pipeline.

devon: yep. otel-go-hook wraps context with its own logger using logx.WithFields which bypasses the global scrub step. Quick mitigation: add a middleware early that sets context logger to a wrapper that enforces redaction, e.g. `WithRedactingLogger(ctx)`.

sam: long-term we should centralize redaction at the encoder level in logx so any logger instance, context-bound or not, goes through the scrubber. Also add unit test that creates a context-bound logger and ensures payload keys are redacted.

kai: can we add a CI policy that fails on any raw-email regex inside JSON logs produced by the sampleapp under `make test-logs`?
devon: good idea. Add a grep in CI that runs the sampleapp in test mode and checks for email/phone regex in the structured output.

rachel: opened PR #2005: wraps context logger in WithRedactingLogger, adds encoder-level scrub fallback, and CI grep. Put repro harness in /scripts/go-structured-repro.sh.

sam: add a metric volatile_redactor_hit when we detect a bypass so Optimize can alert. Also add a short changelog note and a backport to 1.1.x for dedicated customers.

kai: QA note: on Windows the old log driver behaves slightly differently; test there too.

telemetry-bot: sampleapp/go/staging v2.1.0 -> deploy queued :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

rachel: will add tests and ping @sam for metric names. Thanks team.
